role.roleTitle: Data Quality Engineer, Logistics Delivery Services

evidence.text: Owned the scan-event data quality programme for the delivery division for two and a half years, deciding which quality rules were enforced at ingestion as the programme's named owner in the data governance register, and switching rules between warn and block modes under my own authority.
Responsibilities included programme ownership, rule decisions, rule-engine development, dashboards and the weekly quality review for scan-event data over about two and a half years.
Built and maintained the quality-rule engine (Python rules evaluated in the ingestion pipeline) and the quality dashboards showing rule breaches per depot and driver app version.
Led the weekly data quality review with depot operations, deciding which breaches were escalated to depot managers and recording the decisions in the review log.

Coordinated rule changes with the settlement and platform teams through the data change process, recording that the settlement team owned the settlement calculation and the platform team owned the ingestion pipeline while I owned the rules.
